entries.text: The Biter-Proof Underground Belt has touched down on Vulcanus after about 6 hours. Lava, volcanoes and a lot of rock to hit. Here are some tools for the first few minutes of regret.

The team has discovered Gleba, and the Steam-Powered Rail Signal, holding the fort alone, is now responsible for whatever grows there. Ten team milestones in. Please keep the spoilage away from the repair packs.

The team has researched Fulgora, a world of lightning and scrap. The Biter-Proof Underground Belt, holding the fort alone, gets to find out what 'recycling' really means. Here are some repair packs for the storms.
Vulcanus discovered. The Biter-Proof Underground Belt, holding the fort alone, has located a planet made of lava and ambition. Have some repair packs for the inevitable foundry-adjacent mishaps.
The Molten Rail Signal has built their first roboport after about two hours on Nauvis. The robots will want somewhere to live, so here are some to move in. Please do not let them near the spaghetti.
The Biter-Proof Underground Belt has built a nuclear reactor after about 3 hours of play. Bold choice for a first reactor, and we hope the neighbours have been told. Well done.
An engineer built their first nuclear reactor.

Space science is researched. the Biter-Proof Underground Belt, holding the fort alone, can now officially say the team has a space program. Here are some space platform foundations to get you off the ground, and a few extras for when you land.
The team built its first space platform.
The team launched its first rocket.

The Biter-Proof Underground Belt has built a rocket silo after about two hours on Nauvis. Most of us are still sorting out the iron belts. The silo is a fine place to start a conversation about ambition, and some rocket fuel to go with it.

The Steam-Powered Rail Signal has built their first locomotive, a mere 1313 minutes in. The trains are coming, and so, inevitably, is the debate about signals. Here are some cargo wagons, train stops and fuel to get things rolling.
